model: the planner role (MiniMax-M3, D029), through the allowlisted model proxy in the cloud
protocol: one live run of explain_v1 on one deployment; cases without an answer are resumed, answered cases are never asked again
an answer reaches an operator only when the check passes; a shown answer that fails the check again is an escape and there must be none
reported, not thresholded: the raw pass rate, the problems the check found, how often a shown answer cites the decisive fact, and how often a change request gets a draft
the corpus views are frozen; the check and the prompt are not changed after this registration
